name: Update Dashboard Metrics
description: Fetch execution traces from activity.metabob.com, query Thompson Sampling data, and generate metrics.json for dashboard visualization. Purely deterministic data collection with bash and file operations.

variables.name: lookbackHours
variables.description: Hours to look back for traces

tasks.description: Fetch execution traces from activity API
Fetch Thompson Sampling parameters (alpha/beta) for activities
Calculate Thompson Sampling selection efficiency metrics
Commit metrics updates and push to repository

command.run:
git add dashboard/data/*.json dashboard/data/traces/*.json && git commit -m 'chore(dashboard): update metrics and traces data [automated]

Updated metrics from activity.metabob.com:
- Goal achievement rate: calculated
- Template hit rate: calculated
- Thompson Sampling stats: updated
- Trace index: {{lookbackHours}}h lookback

Co-Authored-By: MiniBob <minibob@metabob.com>' && git push origin HEAD

produces.description: Dashboard metrics.json and traces/index.json generated and committed

metadata.description: Purely deterministic metrics collection - no LLM usage, just API calls and bash calculations
